senses.gloss: קִלֵּס (denom. of קוֹלָס) to put a helmet on; part. pass. מְקוּלָּס an animal roasted in its entirety with the entrails and legs on the head.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 74a">Pes. 74ᵃ</cite> R. Ṭarfon called it <he>גדי מ׳</he> a kid with a helmet on.
Tosef. Bets. II, 15 איזוהי גדי מ׳ … וקרבו (not בקרבו) what is a g’di m’ḳullas? Entirely roasted, with head, legs, and entrails.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:15">Ib.</cite> <he>עגל מ׳</he> a calf roasted with the head &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:15">Ib.</cite> Todos taught the Roman Jews to take lambs <he>ועושין אותו מְקוּלָּסִין וכ׳</he> and prepare them ‘helmeted’ on Passover nights.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>מקולסין</he>, v. <cite ref="N00777"><he>נִיקְלְוָוס</he></cite>.]
